About DEVCON Philippines

A non-profit built by volunteers since 2009.

DEVCON Philippines (DevConnect Philippines Inc.) is the country’s largest and longest-running volunteer tech community, an SEC-registered, BIR-compliant non-profit for developers, IT students, educators, and tech enthusiasts.

In 2026 we celebrate our 17th anniversary with 13 locations nationwide, all working toward one vision: a technology-empowered Philippines for all.

  • SEC-registered and BIR-compliant

FAQ

DEVCON Philippines, in short

What is DEVCON Philippines?

DEVCON Philippines (DevConnect Philippines Inc.) is the country’s largest volunteer tech community. It is an SEC-registered, BIR-compliant non-profit founded in 2009, with 13 locations across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

Are DEVCON events free?

Most DEVCON events are free, including code camps, campus talks, meetups, and Hour of AI sessions. Register for upcoming events on DEVCON+.

Where is DEVCON in the Philippines?

DEVCON has 13 locations: Manila, Laguna, Legazpi, and Pampanga in Luzon; Cebu, Iloilo, Bohol, Bacolod, and Tacloban in the Visayas; and Davao, Cagayan de Oro, Iligan, and Bukidnon in Mindanao. The DEVCON HQ Office is at Makati or Ortigas.

What AI programs does DEVCON run?

Hour of AI for kids, free open-source AI code camps, the AI Fluency Masterclass for Builders with an Agentic AI Hackathon, 5-month AI Engineering Internships, and AI Certification Scholarships starting with Claude.

How can a company or organization partner with DEVCON?

Partners run DevRel code camps, sponsor summits, fund AI Certification Scholarships and internships, or donate to DEVCON Kids. Email hello@devcon.ph or visit the Partner page.

How do I volunteer or start a chapter?

Volunteer through your nearest chapter or on DEVCON+. To bring DEVCON to a new city, use the Invite DEVCON page and read the Community Playbook.
